spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/outdoor-store/issues/47. Source revision: 2026-10-13T07:50:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Map orders and write them in one transaction
tasks.body:
Map `Order` and `OrderLine` to the existing tables in `src/Contoso.Outdoor.Data.Core` and add an order writer that saves an order and its lines in one transaction.

## Acceptance criteria
- An order written by EF Core matches the existing schema (tables, columns, keys and status values) so the legacy app reads it.
- No migration is added.
- Order totals come from PriceCalculator.

tasks.title: Port the checkout review and address step
tasks.body:
Port the `Index` GET and POST actions of CheckoutController (cart review and delivery address) and their view; the address stays in the remote session as in the legacy app.

## Acceptance criteria
- Same URL, validation messages, anti-forgery validation and redirect after a valid address.
- Signed-out shoppers are sent to `/Account/Login` with the same return URL.
- `PlaceOrder`, `Pay` and `Confirm` are still forwarded.

tasks.title: Alert on checkout failures in the new host
tasks.body:
Add an Application Insights log alert in `infra/` that notifies the team when checkout requests served by the new host fail.

## Acceptance criteria
- The alert is defined in Bicep and deploys with azd.
- It covers only requests the new host serves.
- No secret or personal data is in the alert definition.

tasks.title: Port order placement with a hand-off to legacy payment
tasks.body:
Port `PlaceOrder`: the new host creates the pending order with the order writer and redirects to the legacy `/Checkout/Pay/{id}`, which keeps calling the payment provider.

## Acceptance criteria
- The legacy payment and confirmation pages read orders created by the new host.
- Same redirect and anti-forgery behaviour as the legacy action.
- `Pay` and `Confirm` stay forwarded to the legacy app.
